title: RMOS-CONVERGE-001B: split AST witnesses under the complexity ratchet
intent: Follow-up on #314 after #320 merged the stacked retract-contract work and #314 declared the combined diff on the output-governance manifest (398e0254). debt-gates still fails: test_authorization_structurally_precedes_generation (26) and test_generation_is_unreachable_before_authorization (16) exceed complexity 15. CBSP21 selection was already resolved on #314 by 398e0254 (output-governance declares the whole landed diff; compat-contract retained as the record of that patch).
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Not a second census or a new retract evaluator. 398e0254 cleared the CBSP21 tie; this patch is the remaining red gate on #314 — the complexity ratchet on the two AST witnesses written as single functions. Assertions and meaning are unchanged.
